'''Roger McEldowney''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 108 from Columbus, OH, whose slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> At [[DecipherCon 1999]] he finished 41st in [[Young Jedi]] Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

A math teacher at Newark High School in Ohio, he played from the game's release.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
